Loading packages:

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(googledrive)
library(googlesheets4)
library(gridExtra)
library(gtable)
library(grid)
library(ggh4x)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(magick)

```

Data input:

```{r}

GDP <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "GDP") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable")

Population <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Population") %>%
  mutate(value = value/1e6) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable,levels = c("Total","Urban","Rural")))

Land.cover <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Land cover") %>%
  select(Year,
         "Primary forest" = land_cover_primf,
         "Secondary forest" = land_cover_secdf,
         "Urban" = land_cover_urban,
         "Pasture" = land_cover_pastr,
         "Rangeland" = land_cover_range,
         "Cropland" = land_cover_Crops) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  mutate("Land cover" = value*2.471/10000) %>% # Convert to millions of acres
  filter(Year > 1799)

Farm.Clearing <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Farm clearing") %>%
  select("Year", "Forest cleared") %>%
  rename("Farm clearing" = "Forest cleared") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Source = "Birdsey et al. 2006") %>%
  mutate(Units = "Billion board feet")

Timber <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Timber") %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(Source == "Howard and Liang 2019" ~ value*12,
                           T~value)) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable,levels = c("Fuelwood","Industrial wood","Lumber","Other products"))) %>%
  bind_rows(Farm.Clearing)

Grazing <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Grazing") %>%
  select(Variable, Year, value) %>%
  mutate(value = value*1.102)

Aqua <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Aquaculture") %>%
  mutate("Diadromous fishes (10^4 tons)" = `Diadromous fishes`/10000,
         "Mollusks (10^5 tons)" = Mollusks/100000,
         "Marine fishes (10^3 tons)" = `Marine fishes`/1000) %>%
  select(-c("Mollusks", "Diadromous fishes", "Marine fishes")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("Mollusks (10^5 tons)",
                                                "Diadromous fishes (10^4 tons)",
                                                "Marine fishes (10^3 tons)"))) %>%
  na.omit()

Coal <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Coal production") %>%
  mutate("Coal (hundred million short tons)" = `Coal production (short tons)`/1e8) %>%
  select(-`Coal production (short tons)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable")

Fossil <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Oil&Gas") %>%
  mutate("Gas (ten trillion cubic feet)" = `Gas production (billion cubic feet per year)`/1e4,
         "Oil (billion barrels)" = `Oil production (million barrels per year)`/1e3,
         "Total wells x 10^5" = `Total number of wells`/1e5) %>%
  select(-c("Gas production (billion cubic feet per year)",
            "Oil production (million barrels per year)",
            "Total number of wells")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  merge(Coal, all=T) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("Coal (hundred million short tons)",
                                                "Total wells x 10^5",
                                                "Gas (ten trillion cubic feet)",
                                                "Oil (billion barrels)")))

Invasives <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Invasives") %>%
  select(!"Species first recorded per 5 years") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("Vascular plants (United States)",
                                                "Vascular plants (Hawaiian Islands)",
                                                "Aquatic plants (United States)",
                                                "Aquatic animals (United States)")))

Nitrogen <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Fertilizer nitrogen") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Source = "FAO") %>%
  mutate(value = value/1e6)

Phosphorus <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Fertilizer phosphorus") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Source = "FAO") %>%
  mutate(value = value/1e6)

Plastic <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Plastic") %>%
  select(Year, "Plastic pollution") %>%
  rename(Plastic = "Plastic pollution") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !Year, names_to = "Variable") %>%
  mutate(Source = "Kan") %>%
  mutate(value = value/1000)

Pollution <- drive_get("Trends in Drivers Data") %>% 
  read_sheet(sheet = "Pesticides") %>%
  mutate(value = value/1e6) %>%
  merge(Nitrogen, all=T) %>%
  merge(Phosphorus, all=T) %>%
  merge(Plastic, all=T) %>%
  mutate(value = value*1.102) %>% # convert to tons from metric
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("Nitrogen fertilizer",
                                                "Phosphate fertilizer",
                                                "Herbicides",
                                                "Insecticides",
                                                "Fungicides",
                                                "Plastic pollution")))

```

Updating population and GDP figure (Draft 3, 9.5; Draft 4, 9.4)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

Pop.plot <- ggplot(Population, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  xlim(1800, 2025) +
  ylab("Population (millions)") +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

Econ.plot <- ggplot(GDP, aes(x=Year, y=value)) +
  xlim(1800, 2025) +
  ylab("GDP (US Dollars)") +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

Pop.plot + Econ.plot +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1)

ggsave("Population.pdf", width = 7, height = 4)

```

Updating land cover figure (Draft 3, 9.6; Draft 4, 9.5)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

maps <- magick::image_read("LiLandCover.png")

img_plot <- ggplot() + 
  annotation_raster(maps, xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=-Inf, ymax=Inf) +
  theme_void() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1/1.38446)

Land.plot <- ggplot(Land.cover, aes(x=Year, y=`Land cover`, color = Variable)) +
  ylab("Area (millions of acres)") +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cropland" = "#A87932",
                                "Pasture" = "#E3DF64",
                                "Primary forest" = "#79A873",
                                "Rangeland" = "purple",
                                "Secondary forest" = "gray",
                                "Urban" = "#990000")) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.25, 0.5))

Landcover <- img_plot + Land.plot + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a', tag_suffix = ')') +
   plot_layout(widths = c(2,1))

ggsave("Landcover.pdf", width = 12, height = 6)

```

Updating harvesting figure (Draft 3, 9.8; Draft 4, 9.6)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

Aqua.plot <- ggplot(Aqua, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  labs(y = str_wrap("Production", width = 20), x = NULL) +
  xlim(1795, 2025) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "a)")

Timber.plot <- ggplot(Timber, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  xlim(1795, 2025) +
  labs(y = str_wrap("Timber extracted (billion board feet)", width = 20), x = NULL) +
  geom_line(data = Timber %>% filter(Source != "Magerl et al. 2022")) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "b)")

Grazing.plot <- ggplot(Grazing, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  xlim(1795, 2025) +
  ylim(0, 80) +
  labs(y = expression(atop("Grazing pressure", (10^6 ~ "tons C" ~ yr^-1)))) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "c)")

Aqua.plot + Timber.plot + Grazing.plot + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 1)

ggsave("Harvest.pdf", width = 9, height = 5)

```

Updating non-native species figure (Draft 3, 9.10; Draft 4, 9.7)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

ggplot(Invasives, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  ylab("Species first recorded per 5 years") +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.2, 0.8))

ggsave("Invasives.pdf", width = 7, height = 3.5)
```

Updating pollution figure (Draft 3, 9.12; Draft 4, 9.9)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

fertilizers <- Pollution %>%
  filter(Variable %in% c("Nitrogen fertilizer","Phosphate fertilizer"))

pesticides <- Pollution %>%
  filter(Variable %in% c("Fungicides","Herbicides","Insecticides"))

Fertilizer.plot <- ggplot(fertilizers, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  ylab("Million tons") + xlab(NULL) +
  xlim(1948, 2025) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.01, 0.99))

Pesticide.plot <- ggplot(pesticides, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable, linetype = Source)) +
  ylab("Million tons") + xlab(NULL) +
  xlim(1948, 2025) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.01, 0.99))

Plastic.plot <- ggplot(Plastic, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  ylab("Million tons") + xlab(NULL) +
  xlim(1948, 2025) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.01, 0.99))

Fossil.plot <- ggplot(Fossil, aes(x=Year, y=value, color = Variable)) +
  ylab("Production") +
  xlim(1948, 2025) +
  geom_line() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.01, 0.99))

Fertilizer.plot + Pesticide.plot + Plastic.plot + Fossil.plot + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a', tag_suffix = ')') +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1)

ggsave("Pollution.pdf", width = 9, height = 9)

```
